label: rem:assembly-projector-scope
title: Scope of the assembly-projector existence result
html: Existence holds for every \lambda and says nothing about energy or stability. A molecule is stable only when the binding LP/SDP selects this symmetric block as its optimum. The binding energy is the trace-weight gap to the next admissible configuration. The high stability of an aromatic ring follows from the irreducibility of e_{\lambda,(N)} over all N strands, not from the projector's bare existence.
